meaning: This file is a committed static JSON document on GitHub Pages. Receiving it proves only that this exact path was served. It is not a runtime health check, not product readiness, not DSSE-LIVE, and not an uptime claim. GitHub Pages has no process to ping. signer is unavailable: this origin has no DSSE signer and no local key. sha is the last published main revision; a static file cannot contain its own future commit SHA.
readyz_note: /readyz and /readyz/ are HTML directory routes. GitHub Pages may 301 /readyz to /readyz/. The 301 lands on HTML, not JSON. Do not treat them as a health probe.
healthz_note: /healthz is not a file on this origin. GitHub Pages serves 404 HTML for missing paths. That 404 is not a health probe. Do not register /healthz as a health URL.
